test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'COAT' is written as 'XLZG'. How will 'PLAY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Opposite letter according to the English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 
• 'COAT' is written as 'XLZG'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77018c5cda96d6e691c3cd9e22513062dba508fecd8936769b8ea63f3e4f2a2d.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'PLAY' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48807032502532da4c0379e56b4d44fab8d5bfcc0d12d291bae1f69612dd33cb.png] 

Hence, "KOZB" is the correct answer.
